_readme: Thai accessible names for icon-only play-route controls, keyed route -> selector -> label.
THIS FILE IS THE HOME. markup.html, style.css and main.js under src/play/<route>/ are all
rewritten byte-for-byte by scripts/extract-mockup.mjs from the mockup, so a label typed into any
of them is undone by the next extraction. The extractor re-applies this table to its own output,
which is what makes a label survive. Run `node scripts/play-aria-labels.mjs --apply` to push the
table into the route files; scripts/play-icon-label-check.mjs judges the files, never this table.
Selector grammar is three forms, tried most-specific first: '#id', then '[attr="value"]', then
'.class' against one token of the class attribute. The class and attribute forms are what address
a control the route renders once per player, which by definition cannot carry a unique id. Reach
for the narrowest key that works: a class shared with a second button is how a wrong Thai label
gets applied silently, and the gate only asks whether a name is Thai, not whether it is right.
Labels are Thai because a player reads them (CLAUDE.md, Write English / Ship Thai).
